'''January 2001 Surprise tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Aosis cafe, Surprise (Phoenix area), AZ on 6 January 2001. [[Patrick Hug]] won it. It is known from Steve Marshall's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1592">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-06-surprise-phoenix-az-1-6-01d1592/ surprise-phoenix-az-1-6-01], DeckTech (Steve "BlackViper" Marshall, 6 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-06-surprise-phoenix-az-1-6-01d1592/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 6 January 2001
* '''Site:''' Aosis cafe, Surprise (Phoenix area), AZ
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Patrick Hug]]
